question: On October 18, 2025, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and UP Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath jointly flagged off the first batch of BrahMos missiles from the BrahMos Integration and Testing Facility Centre located at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On **October 18, 2025**, the Union Defense Minister **Rajnath Singh** and Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister **Yogi Adityanath** jointly flagged off the **first batch** of **BrahMos missiles** from the **BrahMos Integration and Testing Facility Center**.
 
• This state-of-the-art facility is located in **Lucknow**, specifically in the **Sarojini Nagar** area, and serves as a critical hub for the assembly and testing of the world's fastest supersonic cruise missiles.
 
• The center is a vital part of the **Lucknow Node** of the **Uttar Pradesh Defense Industrial Corridor (UPDIC)**, which aims to make India self-reliant in defense production under the **"Aatmanirbhar Bharat"** initiative.
 
• The facility covers approximately **200 acres** of land and is designed to produce the next generation of missiles, including the **BrahMos-NG (Next Generation)** variant.</l
